title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
abstract: arXiv:2611.29354v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict

translated_title: 端点条件化过程价值：当已知最终状态与成本后，盲端点过程评分还能增加什么
translated_abstract: 轨迹度量承诺提供超越最终答案准确性的信息，但尚无研究测量过当评估已知结果和成本后，过程评分还能增加什么。我们构建了这一比较：一个需要双方都无法看到产物的密封后果实验、一个由最终状态和成本构成的操作基线，以及将评判模型规模与证据访问作为实验因素。在7个Python代码库中158个测试生成任务的1,255条轨迹上，答案是取决于评判模型的。四个4B到14B的评判模型（先推理后评分）所增加的信息与零无法区分；而在相同轨迹上，一个Qwen3 32B评判模型增加了+0.050 AUC（95%置信区间[+0.020, +0.081]），并通过了重新拟合的bootstrap检验（[+0.013, +0.095]）。它所增加的大部分信息可以从八个行为计数器中恢复，因此测试框架应当记录这些信息（在此之上评判模型仅增加+0.020）。评判模型所看到的内容会进一步改变结果：披露最终判定结论……
tldr: 本研究通过1,255条轨迹的实验首次量化了过程评分在已知最终状态和成本后的增量价值，发现其增益高度依赖评判模型规模——只有32B级别的评判模型才能带来显著的AUC提升，且大部分增益可由八个可记录的行为计数器替代。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies for the first time the incremental value of process scores beyond terminal status and cost across 1,255 trajectories, finding that the gain is highly dependent on judge scale—only a 32B judge yields a significant AUC improvement (+0.050), and most of it is recoverable from eight loggable behavioral counters.
